name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-quickbooks
description: AccountingSyncAdapter (epic accounting-erp-sync-adapter) backed by QuickBooks Online's real v3 Accounting API (OAuth2, POST /v3/company/{realmId}/salesreceipt or /invoice) and real webhook signature verification (intuit-signature, HMAC-SHA256). Proves accounting/ERP sync is genuinely swappable to a real provider, same shape as adapter-printful/adapter-printify proved for fulfillment. Public surface is exactly AccountingSyncAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/accounting-sync only, for the types it implements, plus global fetch as the real HTTP client (no new HTTP dependency introduced -- mirrors adapter-printful/adapter-shopify's own convention).
